records.text: talawas na mikita namisiw a rakihan aidi babaw kahuy lia ka mangit

senses.zh: 抬頭看見她的小孩在樹上就哭了
senses.en: Raising her head, she saw her baby on the tree and cried.

records.text: talawas lia ki kaidan kita sen ka rahuay rarazaw

senses.zh: Kaidan 抬頭看見老鷹正在飛過去
senses.en: Kaidan raised his head and saw the hawk passing over him.

records.text: duasaasay ki rubang mamais lawas lai la

senses.zh: 女孩不知道該怎麼辦，只能抬高她的頭
senses.en: The girl didn't know what to do, but raised her head.
